label: Date/time parser layout style
type: the syntax style (Go-standard, flexiblego, or a fourth, 'sanitizedgo', named once in a section header but never defined or placed in the main comparison table) a search:date-time-parser uses to specify its expected format.
evidence: In the Layout Style list, choose the specific layout style you want to use for your date/time parser.
You can choose from the following layout styles for a date/time parser.
note: sanitizedgo is a genuine documentation gap, not modeled beyond this note - see docs-issues/server-search-sanitizedgo-layout-style-undocumented.
relates_to_competency_question: What syntax rules govern how a custom date/time parser's layout string is written?
